adjudication.rationale: In `TopicEmbed.import`, when content changes it does `embed.update_column(:content_sha1, content_sha1)`, which updates only that column and skips normal timestamp updating (including `updated_at`). The diff does not show any code that queries `topic_embeds` by `updated_at` or depends on it for visibility, so the claim about “stale rows are invisible” isn’t verifiable here, but the timestamp-bypass is a concrete, diff-grounded concern.
